text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega had a dance lesson today, so 
when I went over to check on how she was 
doing...
Marvelouuus!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! That tap dance just now was 
marvelous too☆

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really?? I thought we were dancing 
together~☆

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Why? The dance itself is completely 
different.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"That doesn't matter☆ Even if our dances 
are different, it's Marvelous★"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Come on! Let's dance it one more time! 
While shouting "Marvelous☆"!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
With Marvelous lending a hand, the dancing 
will be marvelous too~☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ready, and, MARVELOUS☆★

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I won't say it...! If that were all it 
took to get better at dancing, nobody 
would have to struggle.
choice_data_list: Then I'll say it for you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I won't say it...! If that alone made 
someone better at dancing, nobody would 
have to struggle.
choice_data_list: Then I'll say it for you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! That's the Marvelous call, alright☆ 
Alright then, Ayabe, let's do one more 
song~!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Do whatever you want. I'll do things my 
way.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Nice steps, marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Next is tapping, it's MARVELOUS☆★

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ah, seriously... give me a break...!

Despite her grumblings of dissatisfaction, 
her dancing somehow improved 
significantly... much to her astonishment.

In fact, Marvelous Sunday's concerts have 
a reputation for being powerful and sharp. 
This might just be the secret behind it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
... If I don't see results, I'm quitting 
immediately.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Nice steps, marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The steps...... are nice...... isn't it, 
......marvelous......

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(? It's easy to keep rhythm. Is it because 
I'm focusing on the steps...?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... I've got the hang of it now. 
...There won't be a next time.

From this day forward, her dancing had 
become noticeably sharper.
